data.title: Self-Portrait

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting of a red-haired, bearded man with light skin, painted in short brushstrokes and multicolored dots. The background is likewise a mass of small, closely spaced colored dots, these in green, blue, and red-orange.

data.medium_display: Oil on artist's board, mounted on cradled panel

data.title: The Poet's Garden

thumbnail.alt_text: Lush tall grasses with small white flowers foreground a grove of bushy trees of varying types and heights, their leaves ranging from deep green to golden. Beneath a dense and heavy yellow sky, a small blue triangle suggesting a mountain peak crests above the treeline at far left.

data.medium_display: Oil on canvas

data.title: A Peasant Woman Digging in Front of Her Cottage

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting in tones of gray and brown, with some green and blue, of a woman digging with a garden tool before a structure with a thatched roof that descends almost to the ground. Above her the sky is gray and blue, a haze of clouds.

data.medium_display: Oil on canvas

data.title: The Drinkers

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting of three male figures, two older men in top hats and a younger man with red hair, standing outdoors around a wooden table with a pitcher on it, drinking from glasses. A much smaller, childlike figure at left peers over the table and drinks from a white cup. The scene is rendered in winding paint strokes in shades of green and blue.

data.medium_display: Oil on canvas

data.title: Fishing in Spring, the Pont de Clichy (Asnières)

thumbnail.alt_text: Painting in short strokes of pale blue, green, white, yellow, and pink, of a fisherman in one of two small boats on a river, a tree-lined bank and a bridge in the background.
